title: Genius Challenges and Future Solutions
summary: Looking for fun things to do in Cambridge this weekend with your kids? Head to Cambridge Science Centre to help Dr Villainous with some truly horrible experiments in their bid to win the Evil Genius Awards in our show 'Who Wants to be an Evil Genius?'. Investigating bacteria, vomit, snot and potions sounds pretty evil, but Dr Villainous is actually a very good scientist! Also discover your own ecological system by exploring the people and places that you call home in our 'Human Habitats' lab.

title: Discover the Science Around Us
summary: Looking for fun things to do in Cambridge this weekend with your kids? Head to Cambridge Science Centre to investigate the extraordinary properties of man-made materials in our 'Marvellous Man-Made Materials' show. Witness the effects of a vacuum chamber on Marsha the marshmallow, explore the conductive and fireproof properties of different materials and observe how materials interact with different types of light. Join us to see how marvellous man-made materials keep us safe, cool, and capable

title: STEMtots – Marvellous Magnets
summary: Feel the attraction with our magnet-themed session. Investigate materials that are magnetic and use magnets in a fun art activity.
